'''Stass Allie''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tholothian/Legends|Tholothian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. An [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she shared a bloodline with former Council Member [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], who was [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|murdered]] at the hands of [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] during the war.

Like many of her colleagues, Master Allie was slain during the execution of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].

==Biography==
===Early career===
[[File:StassAllie-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|250px|Stass Allie wielding her green lightsaber.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] native to the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] world [[Tholoth/Legends|Tholoth]], Stass Allie was given over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at a young age to begin her [[Jedi training/Legends|education]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Indeed, her family had already made ties with the Order, the Force running strong through her bloodline; renowned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi Diplomat|diplomat]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] was the cousin of Stass Allie. A student of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Allie ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] after constructing a green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for her own use and passing her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]].<ref name="db" />

As a Knight, Jedi Allie began independent studies in the ways of the [[Jedi Consular]]. Following in her cousin's footsteps, Allie trained rigorously in the art of [[Jedi Diplomat|diplomacy]], becoming a top adviser to many high ranking officials in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Additionally, Allie chose to pursue a specialization in [[Force healing/Legends|healing]], a technique she perfected, eventually earning herself a seat on the [[Circle of Jedi Healers/Legends|Circle of Jedi Healers]]. During this time, the Republic was undergoing a massive [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], pushing her diplomatic skills to the limit.<ref name="db" /><ref name="hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_2.html|Arconan Smuggling Cartel Dismantled}}</ref>

Allie and Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] helped advise [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] amid the crisis, with both Jedi working alongside the highest levels of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Forceful">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/12/imageattack20031202.html|series=Image Attack|text=Forceful Advisors}}</ref> Dispatched by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Allie served alongside Jedi [[Tassida Judrelle]] and [[Quarmall]] as the three overthrew the [[Salt/Legends|salt]] cartel of [[Lojrak Shrag]] based on [[Cona/Legends|Cona]].<ref name="db" /><ref name="hnn" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Had enough?|Stass Allie inquires about her fellow High Council members' continued interest in listening to a recording of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's speech on the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]] before turning off the [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]|<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
After the attempted [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] put the Order on edge, the High Council received word that Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and Senator Amidala had been captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Separatist Council/Legends|leadership]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and sentenced to death. Responding to [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] call to action, Jedi Allie accompanied Master Windu's [[Jedi assault team/Legends|task force]] to rescue their fellow Jedi and the Senator. Landing on the dusty plains of Geonosis, Allie entered the [[Petranaki arena]] and alongside her fellow Jedi, fought against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. As many of her friends and mentors died around her, Jedi Allie remained calm and stood with the survivors in the center of the arena as [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] prepared to have them all slaughtered. Just as the outcome looked bleakest, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived from the sky with several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunships]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Making a perimeter around the survivors, the gunships landed swiftly and the Jedi boarded them. Alongside herself, Stass Allie escaped in a ship with Masters [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Roth-Del Masona]]. Flying out of the arena, Allie would lead [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the first [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AOTC" />

As the war effort moved into high gear, Jedi Allie found herself on far flung worlds leading troops against droids, as she had accepted the role of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the Grand Army. Leading valiantly, Allie continued to perfect her healing abilities, taking on [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] as an acolyte, teaching her the ways of Force healing while Offee continued to study under Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]. Allie had been promoted to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] by the time of the [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Battle of Boz Pity]], a costly battle on a [[Boz Pity/Legends|graveyard world]].<ref name="db" />

===Jedi Council member===
{{Quote|Supreme Chancellor, your guards are going to encircle you. You are not to attempt to leave that circle under any circumstances. Do you understand?|Stass Allie orders Chancellor Palpatine to follow her command while protecting him from General Grievous|<ref name="LOE" />}}
[[File:Ti_Allie_vs_Grievous.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Stass Allie and Shaak Ti protecting Palpatine from Grievous.]]
In the wake of the demise of Allie's cousin, Jedi Master Adi Gallia, a seat was left vacant on the High Council. Not long after the aged diplomat's passing, the surviving members of the august body voted to give Master Allie membership due to her invaluable role as a Jedi Consular,<ref name="SWFC">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''</ref> an offer she accepted. In the months that followed, Master Allie continued to serve as a general, but found herself stationed on Coruscant more frequently. Indeed, Allie was at the Jedi Temple when General Grievous' flagship, the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] appeared over Coruscant with a major invasion force. Accompanying Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], Allie rushed to the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] to find the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and escort him to a secure bunker. Unable to find him at his [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|executive building]] [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|suite]], the pair rushed over to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] where they asked [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] Padmé Amidala, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], and [[Vice Chancellor /Legends|Vice Chancellor]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] about [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] location. While none of them knew his exact location, Allie and Ti ordered the group to get to the bunkers, with Allie offering her [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] to the group to get to safety.<ref name="LOE" />

Arriving at [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]], Allie and Ti were successful at locating Chancellor Palpatine. Palpatine, stubborn to leave despite the pleadings of his trusted aides and [[Red Guard|security forces]], was arguing with the Jedi's demands to leave with them when Grievous himself crashed through the panoramic window in the office. Grabbing the Chancellor, Ti and Allie rushed him out of the building and, after a tiresome chase through the city, the two Jedi left the Chancellor in the care of Jedi [[Foul Moudama]], [[Roron Corobb/Legends|Roron Corobb]], [[Roth-Del Masona]], and [[B'ink Utrila]]. Standing at the entrance to the underground bunker, Allie and Ti awaited the attack that was inevitable. Grievous attacked fast and furiously, his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]] hitting the landing platform with rockets that incapacitated Allie while Ti stood her ground. Despite the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta's]] ability to keep the guards at bay, she failed to see Grievous slip past and down into the bunker, until it was too late.<ref name="Clone Wars 25">{{CW|25}}</ref> With Allie rendered unconscious, Ti rushed alone to the bunker, which she found filled with four dead Jedi and no Chancellor.<ref name="LOE" /> She managed to catch up with Grievous and Palpatine, but was subdued by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]].<ref name="Clone Wars 25" /> Returning to the surface in defeat, she found Master Allie being tended to by Masters Windu and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. The Jedi returned to the Temple, defeated; Master Ti and Master Allie rested in the [[Halls of Healing]], not partaking in one High Council meeting in the immediate aftermath of the battle.<ref name="LOE" />

===Order 66===
Having made a full recovery in the days following the attack on Coruscant, Master Allie prepared to leave Coruscant on a mission that would bring reinforcements to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] to aid Master [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and Jedi [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] in the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|struggle]] there. As she prepared to board her transport, Allie was halted by Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], recently elected Knight to the High Council, who informed her that she had been reassigned to lead clean-up operations on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], a planet which had been [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|fought over]] for some time. With Master Vos moving to Boz Pity, it was up to Master Allie to see the recovery of all valuable intelligence and machinery from the battlefield.<ref name="Reversal">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref>

[[File:Stassdeath.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The death of Stass Allie.]]
Arriving on Saleucami, Master Allie joined the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]] members [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]] and his wingman, [[CT-3423]] in patrolling the bleak battle-ridden landscape of the world on [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]]. As they traveled along a small stream, Commander Neyo received an executive order from Coruscant. Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, unbeknownst to any within the Grand Army, was the alter-ego of the mysterious [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious. Sidious, in his persona as Chancellor, issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], demanding the immediate execution of all Jedi, branding them as traitors. As Master Allie continued her flight unaware, Neyo and his wingman backed off and opened fire on their general, obeying their orders without questions. As her speeder bike was struck by the blasterfire, Master Stass Allie was killed instantly as the explosion tossed her corpse into the grasses of the dreary planet.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Legacy===
As the Jedi were slaughtered across the stars, both the Republic and the Jedi Order were disbanded, replaced with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-run [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In order to cast the Jedi in a bad light, [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine ordered his aide, [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], to compile an [[Casualty Report: Order 66|official piece]] of propaganda which detailed the Empire's version of events. The public was made aware by these reports that Master Stass Allie, devoted healer and well-known political adviser, was executed while heading to a rendezvous point arranged by Separatist terrorists to aid in a plot against the Republic.<ref name="DAJ" />

Years after her death, the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] Jedi, [[Kazdan Paratus]], had erected a massive [[Junk Temple|replica of the Jedi Temple]] on the junk world of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. Inside a cobbled together replica of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]], the insane Paratus had built a junk puppet of Master Allie, reenacting Council meetings in his solitude. Paratus' pitiful existence was ended however when [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] raided the compound, killing the unhinged Jedi and beheading the Allie puppet in the process.<ref name="ForceUnleashed">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
A tall, slender woman, Stass Allie was devoted to the art of [[Force healing/Legends|healing]] and diplomacy, following in the footsteps of her cousin Jedi Master Adi Gallia. Described as clever and valiant by her fellow Council members, Stass Allie was extremely loyal to the Jedi and the Republic. Despite her Jedi heritage, Allie researched her native people of [[Tholoth/Legends|Tholoth]] and, like her cousin, she adorned her head with a traditional [[Tholoth headdress/Legends|Tholoth headdress]]. While she preferred diplomacy when at all possible, Allie conceded her belief that in many cases peace could only be achieved through battle.<ref name="RotSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker considered her a friend and personally thanked her for saving Padme Amidala's life.<ref name="Reversal" />

==Powers and abilities==
Like all Jedi, Master Stass Allie was educated in the ways of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], becoming proficient enough to withstand the mass volume of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts flying her way during the opening battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A wise and powerful healer, Allie sat on the [[Circle of Jedi Healers/Legends|Circle of Jedi Healers]], overseeing the work done by the [[Medical Corps/Legends|Medical Corps]]. Her knowledge of the Force and her diplomatic ties were considered so valuable that she was given a seat on the High Council of the Jedi Order during a time of war and chaos.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
The creation of the character of Stass Allie is in many ways a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] which took place prior to the release of any [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] products. It was the filmmaker's intentions to use the majority of Jedi High Council members in the film's climatic [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]; however, as the majority of the film was being shot in Australia instead of England, local model [[Lily Nyamwasa]] replaced [[Gin Clarke]] who portrayed [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|first film]]. Nyamwasa filmed all of the battle scenes as well as the scene in Palpatine's office wearing Gallia's costume. However, similarly with the case of [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]]/[[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], the filmmakers found that Nyamwasa's appearance was too distinct from Clarke's to cast her as the same character. Therefore, to correct this, Gallia's cousin Stass Allie was created and a suitable backstory was created, and an explanation crafted for Gallia's seeming absence from the battle. As this discrepancy of appearance was noted early on, virtually no sources misidentify either Jedi aside from color differences in lightsaber blades in some promotional images.

Nyamwasa returned to reprise her role as Allie for the filming of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], appearing in several pieces of promotional art and in the ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''. However, Nyamwasa was not available for pick-up shoots, and was replaced by two different actresses. Portrayed in [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] form during the second Council scene by [[Tace Bayliss]], the role would then go to [[Nina Fallon]] during her death scene. While Nyamwasa was cut entirely from the film, her likeness continues to represent the official appearance of Stass Allie, being the only model to appear in any licensed merchandise.

[[Dave Filoni]], Supervising Director of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, stated in [[January]] [[2013]] that his crew had already made a model for Stass Allie to appear at a future date in the series, following the death of Adi Gallia in "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]."<ref name="Filoni RFR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.rebelforceradio.com/shows/2015/9/28/rebel-force-radio-january-19-2013-premiere|text=Rebel Force Radio: January 19, 2013 (Premiere)|work=[[Rebel Force Radio]]|archivedate=20230828084324}} {{C|46:15}}</ref>
